text.p: Digital Equipment Corp said Wednesday that its software to search and index information on the computer desktop is available and has been priced at $29.95.
The software is known as AltaVista Search My Computer PX. It is for use with Windows 95 and Windows NT documents on personal computers.
The company said it will be available for downloading on the World Wide Web on December 5, or from resellers beginning December 16.
Until November 18, a special price of $19.95 is available for AltaVista Visionary Club members on the World Wide Web.

The software is designed to give Internet and intranet users a tool for finding information and to seamlessly search from the World Wide Web to their personal computer and back again without changing applications or learning new interfaces, Digital said.
